title: Product Manager
jobDescription: ThirdEye Data is looking for a Product Manager to own the end-to-end product lifecycle for our AI-powered enterprise products. You will define product vision, create product requirements, prioritize features, and work closely with engineering and business teams to deliver high-quality products that align with customer needs and business goals. Key Responsibilities Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap. Own the product lifecycle from ideation to launch. Create Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and feature specifications. Prioritize product backlog and drive sprint planning. Collaborate with Engineering, AI, UX, QA, and Project Management teams. Gather customer feedback and conduct market and competitor analysis. Track product performance and drive continuous improvements. Support product launches with Sales and Marketing teams. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Business, or a related field. 4-6 years of Product Management experience. Mandatory experience working with an IT Consulting, Technology Consulting, AI Consulting, or Software Services company. Mandatory hands-on experience managing AI/Generative AI products , with a strong understanding of technologies such as LLMs, AI Agents, Machine Learning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or Intelligent Document Processing (IDP). Strong experience creating PRDs, user stories, product roadmaps, and working in Agile environments. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and analytical skills. Preferred Skills Experience with Azure AI, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or other cloud-based AI platforms. Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar product management tools. Ability to work with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consulting environment.

title: Solution Architect
jobDescription: ThirdEye Data is seeking an experienced Solution Architect to design and deliver enterprise-grade AI, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Cloud solutions for global customers. The ideal candidate will work closely with clients to understand business challenges, architect scalable solutions, and provide technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle. This role requires strong consulting experience, excellent client engagement skills, and the ability to bridge business requirements with technology solutions. Key Responsibilities Engage with enterprise customers to understand business objectives, challenges, and technical requirements. Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI, Data Engineering, Analytics, Cloud, and Digital Transformation initiatives. Lead solution discovery workshops, architecture discussions, and technical presentations with customers. Create solution architecture documents, technical specifications, architecture diagrams, and implementation roadmaps. Collaborate with Product Managers, Project Managers, AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Software Development teams to ensure successful solution delivery. Evaluate and recommend the most appropriate technologies, frameworks, and cloud platforms based on business needs. Ensure solution scalability, performance, security, reliability, and maintainability. Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance throughout the software development lifecycle. Participate in pre-sales activities, including customer meetings, solution demonstrations, RFP/RFI responses, solution estimation, and proposal preparation. Review technical designs, resolve complex technical challenges, and mentor engineering teams. Stay updated on emerging technologies and recommend innovative approaches to improve customer solutions. Mandatory Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 10 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Technical Architecture, or related roles. Mandatory experience working with an IT Consulting, Technology Consulting, AI Consulting, Digital Transformation, or Software Services company delivering enterprise solutions to global clients. Experience working directly with enterprise customers, gathering business requirements, and translating them into scalable technical solutions. Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile, and DevOps methodologies. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and consulting skills. Ability to lead architecture discussions with business stakeholders, technical teams, and executive leadership. Technical Skills Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning, and Generative AI Data Engineering and Big Data technologies (Apache Spark, Kafka, Hadoop/HDFS, Databricks, Delta Lake) Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Services Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Data Warehousing, ETL/ELT, Data Lakes, and Modern Data Platforms REST APIs, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, and Enterprise Integration SQL and NoSQL Databases Docker, Kubernetes, and Containerized Deployments CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure Automation Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI Agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), or Computer Vision solutions. Experience supporting digital transformation initiatives across multiple industries. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Services, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar modern data platforms. Cloud certifications such as Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or Google Professional Cloud Architect are preferred. TOGAF certification is an added advantage. Preferred Candidate Profile Strong consulting mindset with excellent customer engagement and solutioning capabilities. Experience working with global clients across multiple industries. Ability to lead technical solutioning from discovery through implementation. Experience supporting pre-sales activities, solution estimation, proposal development, and proof-of-concept engagements. Proven ability to mentor technical teams and drive architectural best practices. Comfortable managing multiple enterprise engagements in a fast-paced consulting environment.

title: Contract Video Editor
jobDescription: We’re seeking a talented and detail-oriented Video Editor to join our team on a contract basis. You’ll work closely with our [creative/marketing/content] team to edit compelling video content for various platforms, including web, social media, and digital campaigns. This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about storytelling through video, has a strong creative vision, and can deliver high-quality edits under tight deadlines. Responsibilities Edit raw footage into polished, engaging video content aligned with brand guidelines and project objectives Collaborate with creative directors, producers, and the marketing team to understand the vision and narrative Add music, sound effects, graphics, and other elements to enhance videos Optimize videos for different platforms (YouTube, Instagram, website, etc.) Ensure all content meets technical standards and brand consistency Revise videos based on stakeholder feedback within set deadlines Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high quality Organize and maintain video assets and project files Requirements Proven experience as a video editor (portfolio required) Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, and post-production workflow Familiarity with motion graphics, color grading, and sound design Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment Excellent time management and communication skills Bonus: Experience editing for social media or branded content
